assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide classroom cover. A single wide establishing scene for a Chinese first-grade number lesson, an original welcoming community craft post office with warm apricot walls, a mint trim window and a deep blue postal satchel motif. Two six-year-old children and one small friendly owl are behind a wide clean light wooden counter preparing to sort. The counter is empty; any background furniture and decorations are very sparse. Clearly readable large shapes, colored pencil with soft gouache, warm daylight. No words, numbers, characters, logos, real postal brands or countable loose props on the counter. Illustrated for Chinese first-grade mathematics. Warm muted colored-pencil and soft gouache children’s book style, clean object outlines, little texture, simple readable silhouettes, warm daylight. No words, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.
